Visitors are contractors, developers, consultants, government project owners and procurement teams, and the free CPD-certified talks programme is a significant draw for engineers.
whatToExpect: Multiple halls organised by product sector with live machinery and materials demonstrations, plus free CPD-certified workshops and leadership summits on in-hall stages. Expect large contractor delegations, country pavilions and heavy on-stand negotiation across four days.
venueAddress: Riyadh Front, Airport Road, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Saudi Industrial Expo 2026
tagline: The Kingdom's manufacturing and industrial technology exhibition, co-located with Big 5 Construct Saudi.
shortDescription: Saudi Industrial Expo returns for its second edition 30 August to 1 September 2026 at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Conference Center, covering industrial machinery, automation and manufacturing supply chains.
description:
The Saudi Industrial Expo is a manufacturing and industrial technology trade show launched by dmg events to serve the Kingdom's industrial localisation drive. Its second edition runs from 30 August to 1 September 2026 at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Conference Center, co-located with Big 5 Construct Saudi and the Saudi Wood Expo.

The scope covers industrial machinery and machine tools, factory automation and robotics, materials handling, industrial electrical and power systems, metalworking, welding and fabrication, and maintenance and reliability services. It is aimed at Saudi manufacturers upgrading plant capability and at international suppliers seeking entry into an industrial base that is expanding rapidly outside the traditional petrochemical core.

The policy backdrop is the National Industrial Development and Logistics Program, which targets a significant increase in the number of factories in the Kingdom and higher local content across sectors including automotive, pharmaceuticals, defence, food processing and building materials. Visitors include factory owners and plant managers, procurement teams, industrial engineers and government industrial development agencies, and the co-location with construction means many contractors also cross the floor.
whatToExpect: An exhibition of industrial machinery and automation equipment with live demonstrations, alongside supplier and service stands. Expect shared access with the co-located Big 5 Construct Saudi halls, technical seminars, and factory-owner and plant-manager visitor traffic.
venueAddress: Riyadh Front, Airport Road, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Saudi Warehousing and Logistics Expo 2026
tagline: Saudi Arabia's dedicated exhibition for warehousing, freight, cold chain and last-mile logistics.
shortDescription: The Saudi Warehousing & Logistics Expo runs 8-10 September 2026 at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Conference Center, with 350-plus exhibiting companies across warehousing, freight, cold chain and fulfilment.
description:
The Saudi Warehousing & Logistics Expo is organised by dmg events and runs from 8 to 10 September 2026 at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Conference Center. It covers warehousing and storage systems, materials handling and racking, cold chain, freight forwarding and multimodal transport, ports and terminals, fleet and commercial vehicles, last-mile delivery and e-commerce fulfilment, and third-party logistics services, with more than 350 exhibiting companies presenting several thousand products and services.

The show exists because logistics is one of the most heavily backed sectors in Vision 2030. The National Transport and Logistics Strategy aims to make Saudi Arabia a global logistics hub connecting three continents, with targets including a large expansion of special economic and logistics zones, major port throughput increases, and a national rail and road build-out. That has produced a construction and equipment pipeline for warehousing capacity across Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam and the industrial cities.

Visitors are logistics operators and 3PLs, e-commerce and retail supply-chain managers, industrial and FMCG distribution teams, port and free-zone authorities, and investors in logistics real estate. A conference programme runs alongside covering automation and warehouse robotics, cold-chain compliance, customs and cross-border trade facilitation, and supply-chain digitalisation.
whatToExpect: Exhibition halls of racking, forklifts, conveyors and automation systems with live demonstrations, plus service-provider and technology stands. Expect a free conference stage on supply-chain topics and strong attendance from 3PLs, e-commerce operators and industrial distributors.
venueAddress: Riyadh Front, Airport Road, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: LEAP 2026
tagline: The Middle East's largest technology event, gathering global tech brands, startups and investors in Riyadh.
shortDescription: LEAP 2026 runs 31 August to 3 September 2026 at the Riyadh Exhibition & Convention Center in Malham, with more than 200,000 expected visitors, 1,800 tech brands, 600 startups and 1,900 investors.
description:
LEAP is Saudi Arabia's flagship technology event and the largest tech gathering in the Middle East, launched in 2022 by Tahaluf, a joint venture between Informa, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP) and the Events Investment Fund. The 2026 edition runs from 31 August to 3 September at the Riyadh Exhibition & Convention Center in Malham, moving from its traditional February slot.

The scale is the defining feature: more than 200,000 visitors are expected alongside over 1,800 global tech brands, 600 startups, 1,900 investors and more than 1,000 speakers. Content is organised across tracks covering fintech, smart cities, health technology, edtech, industrial and Fourth Industrial Revolution technologies, the creative economy, cloud and infrastructure, and enterprise software, with separate stages for developers and for executive audiences.

LEAP matters to MENA technology and business because it is where Saudi Arabia's largest technology investment announcements are typically made, frequently running into tens of billions of dollars in commitments from hyperscalers, telecom operators and sovereign-backed vehicles. Its startup programme, Rocket Fuel, runs pitch competitions and investor matchmaking, and the co-located DeepFest gives the AI ecosystem its own dedicated platform within the same footprint.
whatToExpect: Vast exhibition halls with hyperscaler and enterprise pavilions, a large dedicated startup zone with country and accelerator clusters, and multiple content stages running in parallel. Expect investor matchmaking programmes, hackathons and developer sessions, plus evening networking across Riyadh.
venueAddress: Malham, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
organizerName: Tahaluf (Informa with SAFCSP and the Events Investment Fund)

title: DeepFest 2026
tagline: The AI event co-located with LEAP in Riyadh, arriving as Saudi Arabia marks 2026 as its Year of AI.
shortDescription: DeepFest 2026 runs 31 August to 3 September 2026 at the Riyadh Exhibition & Convention Center, co-located with LEAP and dedicated to the global artificial intelligence ecosystem.
description:
DeepFest is the artificial intelligence event co-located with LEAP at the Riyadh Exhibition & Convention Center in Malham, running from 31 August to 3 September 2026. It was created as a dedicated home for the AI ecosystem inside the wider LEAP footprint, and returns in 2026 as Saudi Arabia designates the year its Year of Artificial Intelligence.

The event convenes AI researchers and data scientists, big-tech AI leadership, enterprise AI adopters, academics, startups and policymakers. Programming covers foundation models and generative AI, Arabic-language large language models, applied AI in healthcare, energy, finance and government services, computer vision and robotics, AI infrastructure and compute, and the governance questions around safety, bias and regulation.

DeepFest carries particular weight because of the scale of Saudi Arabia's AI build-out: SDAIA's national AI strategy, the HUMAIN national AI company established under PIF, large-scale data-centre and compute investments, and sovereign partnerships with global chipmakers and model developers. For regional startups and enterprises, DeepFest is the main annual venue where those national programmes meet commercial opportunity, and it runs alongside LEAP's investor and startup programmes so AI founders get access to both audiences.
whatToExpect: A dedicated AI exhibition zone and content stages inside the LEAP venue, with model and product demos, research showcases and enterprise case studies. Expect hands-on technical workshops, an AI startup showcase, and access to the full co-located LEAP exhibition on the same badge.
venueAddress: Malham, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
organizerName: Tahaluf (Informa with SAFCSP and the Events Investment Fund)

title: HR Summit and Expo Saudi Arabia 2026
tagline: HRSE KSA, the Kingdom's largest human resources conference and exhibition, run by Informa Connect.
shortDescription: HRSE KSA 2026 takes place 1-2 September 2026 in Riyadh with certified workshops on 30-31 August, drawing over 4,500 HR professionals from across the Kingdom.
description:
The HR Summit and Expo Saudi Arabia (HRSE KSA) is the Kingdom's largest dedicated human resources event, organised by Informa Connect. The 2026 main conference and exhibition runs on 1 and 2 September in Riyadh, preceded by certified professional workshops on 30 and 31 August, and typically attracts more than 4,500 HR professionals.

The agenda addresses the specific pressures of the Saudi labour market: Saudisation and Nitaqat compliance, large-scale recruitment for giga-projects, female workforce participation which has risen sharply in recent years, learning and development at national scale, HR technology and payroll systems, employee experience and retention in a competitive talent market, and the impact of AI on job design and workforce planning.

Attendees are chief human resources officers, talent acquisition and L&D leaders, HR operations and total-rewards specialists, and government human-capital bodies. Exhibitors include HR technology vendors, recruitment and executive search firms, training providers, benefits and insurance companies, and consultancies. The certified workshop programme provides continuing professional development credit, which makes the event a practical skills investment as well as a networking venue.
whatToExpect: A two-day conference with multiple content tracks alongside an exhibition of HR technology and service providers, plus separately bookable certified workshops. Expect CHRO-level panels, practical case-study sessions from large Saudi employers, and structured networking.
venueAddress: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Jeddah International Beauty Expo 2026
tagline: The western region's beauty, cosmetics and personal care exhibition at the Jeddah Superdome.
shortDescription: The Jeddah International Beauty Expo runs 6-8 September 2026 at the Jeddah Superdome, covering cosmetics, skincare, hair, fragrance and salon and spa equipment.
description:
The Jeddah International Beauty Expo is the western region's dedicated beauty and personal care trade exhibition, held from 6 to 8 September 2026 at the Jeddah Superdome. It complements the Riyadh-based Beautyworld show by serving the Makkah Province market, which combines a large domestic consumer base with the significant pilgrim-visitor economy around Makkah and Madinah.

Exhibit categories cover colour cosmetics and skincare, hair care and salon products, fragrance and traditional Arabian perfumery, nail and lash services, professional salon and spa equipment, and packaging and private-label manufacturing. Jeddah's role as the Kingdom's main Red Sea import gateway makes it a natural distribution hub, so the show attracts importers and wholesalers alongside brand owners.

Visitors include salon and spa operators, pharmacy and beauty retail chains, distributors and importers, beauty entrepreneurs and social-commerce sellers, and professional make-up artists and stylists. The show typically features live demonstration stages for hair and make-up artistry, competitions, and sessions on regulatory registration with the Saudi Food and Drug Authority, which is a practical hurdle for any brand entering the market.
whatToExpect: An exhibition floor of brand and distributor stands with live hair and make-up demonstration stages, product sampling and competitions. Expect a mix of trade buyers and beauty professionals, plus consumer visitors during public hours.
venueAddress: Madinah Road, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

title: STATIC Arabia 2026
tagline: The Middle East static equipment technology and innovation conference at Dhahran Expo.
shortDescription: The sixth STATIC Arabia runs 8-10 September 2026 at Dhahran Expo in Al Khobar, hosting over 5,000 professionals from the energy, oil and gas, petrochemical and power sectors.
description:
STATIC Arabia is the Middle East's specialist conference and exhibition for static equipment technology, held at Dhahran Expo in Al Khobar in the heart of Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province energy cluster. The sixth edition runs from 8 to 10 September 2026 and expects more than 5,000 professionals from the energy, oil and gas, petrochemical and power generation sectors.

Static equipment covers pressure vessels, heat exchangers, boilers, storage tanks, columns, piping and valves — the fixed assets that make up the bulk of a refinery or petrochemical plant's capital base. The technical programme addresses materials and corrosion, welding and fabrication standards, inspection and non-destructive testing, integrity management and remaining-life assessment, turnaround planning, and increasingly the adaptation of existing assets for hydrogen and low-carbon service.

The location is deliberate: Dhahran and Al Khobar sit alongside Saudi Aramco's headquarters and the Jubail industrial city, giving the event direct access to the operators, EPC contractors and inspection service providers that dominate Gulf plant engineering. Delegates are plant reliability and integrity engineers, inspection specialists, fabrication shop owners, and procurement teams from operators and contractors across the region.
whatToExpect: A technical conference of peer-reviewed papers and case studies running alongside an exhibition of fabricators, inspection service providers and materials suppliers. Expect a strongly engineering-led audience from Aramco, SABIC and their contractor base, plus training workshops.
venueAddress: Dhahran Expo, Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia

title: Money20/20 Middle East 2026
tagline: The global fintech brand's Middle East edition in Riyadh, successor to the 24 Fintech conference.
shortDescription: Money20/20 Middle East runs 14-16 September 2026 at the Riyadh Exhibition & Convention Center in Malham, expecting 38,500-plus visitors, 350 brands, 600 investors and 150 startups.
description:
Money20/20 Middle East is the regional edition of the world's best-known fintech conference brand, staged in Riyadh from 14 to 16 September 2026 at the Riyadh Exhibition & Convention Center in Malham. It succeeds and absorbs 24 Fintech, the Saudi fintech conference launched in 2024 by the Financial Sector Development Program with the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA), the Capital Market Authority and the Insurance Authority.

The 2026 event expects more than 38,500 visitors alongside 350-plus brands, 350 speakers, over 600 investors and around 150 startups. Content covers payments infrastructure and real-time rails, open banking and API regulation, digital and neo-banking, embedded finance, Islamic fintech, insurtech, wealth and capital-markets technology, digital assets and tokenisation, and the regulatory sandbox regimes operated by Saudi authorities.

The event matters because Saudi Arabia has become the fastest-growing fintech market in the region by licensed-entity count, with SAMA's Fintech Saudi initiative driving a jump from a handful of licensed fintechs to several hundred. Bringing the Money20/20 brand to Riyadh signals an intent to make the Kingdom the region's fintech convening point, and the event functions as a meeting place between regulators, incumbent banks, global payment networks and the startup ecosystem.
whatToExpect: A large exhibition floor of banks, payment networks, infrastructure vendors and startup pavilions, with several content stages and a dedicated startup pitch programme. Expect regulator keynotes from SAMA and CMA, structured investor meetings and heavy evening networking.
venueAddress: Malham, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
organizerName: Money20/20 with the Financial Sector Development Program

title: Global AI Summit 2026
tagline: GAIN, SDAIA's flagship artificial intelligence summit, returning to Riyadh for its fourth edition.
shortDescription: The fourth Global AI Summit (GAIN) runs 15-17 September 2026 at the King Abdulaziz International Conference Center in Riyadh, organised by SDAIA under royal patronage.
description:
The Global AI Summit, known as GAIN, is Saudi Arabia's premier international artificial intelligence conference, organised by the Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA) under the patronage of the Crown Prince, who chairs SDAIA's board. The fourth edition runs from 15 to 17 September 2026 at the King Abdulaziz International Conference Center in Riyadh, delivered in partnership with the national AI company HUMAIN.

GAIN convenes ministers and regulators, AI researchers, enterprise AI leaders, chipmakers and cloud providers, and startups. Programming spans national AI strategies and governance frameworks, trustworthy and responsible AI, generative models and Arabic-language LLMs, AI compute and data-centre infrastructure, and applied deployments across healthcare, energy, government services, mobility and defence. The summit has previously been the venue for major international AI policy declarations and multilateral working-group launches.

Its significance for MENA business follows from Saudi Arabia's scale of AI investment. SDAIA operates the national data and AI platform, HUMAIN was established under PIF to build sovereign AI capability including large-scale compute, and 2026 has been designated Saudi Arabia's Year of Artificial Intelligence. GAIN is where those national programmes, international partnerships and vendor commitments are made public.
whatToExpect: A conference-led format with ministerial plenaries, technical tracks and research showcases, supported by an exhibition of AI companies, national pavilions and startup displays. Expect access-controlled registration, senior international speakers and significant policy announcements.
venueAddress: King Abdulaziz Road, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
organizerName: Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA)

title: Hotel and Hospitality Expo Saudi Arabia 2026
tagline: The Kingdom's largest hospitality supply trade show, now with a dedicated CoffeeZone.
shortDescription: The Hotel & Hospitality Expo Saudi Arabia runs 15-17 September 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Centre, adding a dedicated CoffeeZone to its hospitality supply floor.
description:
The Hotel & Hospitality Expo Saudi Arabia, formerly The Hotel Show Saudi Arabia, is the Kingdom's largest trade event for the hotel and hospitality supply sector, organised by dmg events and held from 15 to 17 September 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Centre.

The exhibition covers hotel furniture and interiors, bathroom and wellness fit-out, professional kitchen and catering equipment, tableware and amenities, housekeeping and laundry systems, hospitality technology and property management systems, and uniforms and textiles. The 2026 edition introduces CoffeeZone, a dedicated area covering roasting and brewing equipment, speciality blends and café concepts, reflecting the scale of Saudi Arabia's speciality coffee market.

The buyer base is unusually strong because of the Saudi hotel pipeline: tens of thousands of keys are in development across Riyadh, Jeddah, the Red Sea, AlUla, Diriyah, Qiddiya and NEOM, alongside a large existing estate serving religious tourism in Makkah and Madinah. Visitors include hotel owners and operators, F&B group operators, procurement managers, interior designers and fit-out contractors, and the show is paired with a conference programme on hospitality operations, design and technology.
whatToExpect: An exhibition floor split into interiors, kitchen and technology zones plus the new CoffeeZone, with live cooking and barista demonstrations. Expect chef competitions, design feature areas, and procurement teams from major hotel groups working the floor.
venueAddress: 2446 King Abdullah Road, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: INDEX Saudi Arabia 2026
tagline: The Kingdom's largest interiors, furniture and fit-out trade show at RICEC in Riyadh.
shortDescription: INDEX Saudi Arabia runs 15-17 September 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Centre, bringing global and regional interior design, furniture and fit-out brands to the Saudi market.
description:
INDEX Saudi Arabia is the Kingdom's largest trade show for interior design, furniture and fit-out, part of the long-established INDEX brand and held from 15 to 17 September 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Centre. It runs in the same window as the Hotel & Hospitality Expo, giving specifiers and contractors a concentrated sourcing week in Riyadh.

Exhibit categories cover contract and residential furniture, lighting, surfaces and flooring, textiles and soft furnishings, workplace and office interiors, kitchen and bathroom systems, and materials and finishes. Feature areas typically include designer talks, material libraries and installations by Saudi and regional studios, positioning the show as a design event as well as a procurement platform.

Demand is driven by the volume of Saudi interior fit-out work: giga-project hospitality and residential handovers, the Sakani housing programme, large workplace relocations tied to the regional headquarters programme that has moved multinational offices to Riyadh, and the hotel pipeline. Visitors are interior designers and architects, fit-out contractors, developers and asset owners, hospitality and workplace procurement teams, and furniture retailers and distributors.
whatToExpect: A design-led exhibition floor with staged installations, material libraries and brand showcases, plus a talks programme featuring regional and international designers. Expect specifier-heavy visitor traffic and contract furniture suppliers running project meetings on stand.
venueAddress: 2446 King Abdullah Road, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Jeddah International Building and Interior Exhibition 2026
tagline: Western region trade exhibition for building materials, construction and interior finishing.
shortDescription: The Jeddah International Building & Interior Exhibition runs 15-17 September 2026 at the Jeddah Centre for Forums & Events, covering building materials, construction systems and interior finishing.
description:
The Jeddah International Building & Interior Exhibition is the western region's trade platform for building materials, construction systems and interior finishing, held from 15 to 17 September 2026 at the Jeddah Centre for Forums & Events. It serves contractors, developers and specifiers working across Makkah Province and the Red Sea coast.

Product scope covers structural and finishing materials, doors and windows, ceramics and stone, paints and coatings, insulation and waterproofing, electrical and lighting systems, HVAC, and interior fit-out products. Because Jeddah is Saudi Arabia's principal Red Sea import gateway, the show also functions as a distribution and agency-appointment venue for international manufacturers seeking Saudi representation.

The regional demand picture is strong: Jeddah has substantial residential development and waterfront regeneration underway, Makkah and Madinah require continuous hospitality construction to expand pilgrim capacity, and Red Sea Global's resort programme along the coast has generated a long-running materials pipeline. Visitors are contractors, consultants and engineering offices, developers, government project teams, and building materials traders across the western region.
whatToExpect: An exhibition of building materials and interior products with manufacturer and distributor stands, plus material sample displays and technical presentations. Expect western-region contractor and consultant attendance and agency or distribution negotiations with international suppliers.
venueAddress: Jeddah Centre for Forums & Events, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
organizerName: Jeddah International Building & Interior Exhibition organisers

title: Intervision 2026
tagline: The second edition of the international Intervision song contest, hosted by Riyadh.
shortDescription: Saudi Arabia hosts the second edition of the Intervision international song contest in Riyadh in September 2026, the first time the revived multicultural music competition is staged in the Kingdom.
description:
Intervision is a revived international song contest in which participating countries each send a musical act to compete in a televised final. Saudi Arabia was confirmed as host of the second edition, staged in Riyadh in September 2026, marking the first time the contest has been held in the Kingdom and the first outside its founding host country.

The format positions Intervision as a multicultural alternative to Eurovision, with participation weighted toward Asia, Africa, Latin America and the Middle East, and with a jury-led scoring system. Hosting duties involve a full television production build, an international press centre, delegation hosting and a public fan programme around the arena show.

For Saudi Arabia the contest is part of a deliberate push to become a venue for globally broadcast entertainment properties, alongside WWE, boxing, the Esports World Cup and major concert programming under Riyadh Season. It gives the Kingdom's growing live-production sector a large international broadcast project to deliver, and it puts Riyadh in front of a television audience across dozens of participating markets.
whatToExpect: A televised arena production with a live audience, preceded by rehearsal days, delegation press conferences and an international media centre. Expect a fan zone and cultural programme around the host venue, with ticketing through Saudi national platforms.
venueAddress: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
organizerName: Intervision with Saudi Arabian host broadcaster partners

title: 27th Arabian Gulf Cup 2026
tagline: The Gulf's biennial national-team football championship, hosted in Jeddah.
shortDescription: Saudi Arabia hosts the 27th Arabian Gulf Cup in Jeddah from 23 September to 6 October 2026, with eight Gulf nations competing at King Abdullah Sports City and Prince Abdullah Al Faisal Stadium.
description:
The Arabian Gulf Cup is the biennial national-team football championship of the Arab Gulf states, and the 27th edition is hosted by Saudi Arabia in Jeddah from 23 September to 6 October 2026. Bahrain, Iraq, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Yemen compete, with matches confirmed for King Abdullah Sports City Stadium and Prince Abdullah Al Faisal Stadium.

The tournament is one of the oldest regional football competitions in the Middle East and carries substantial prestige and television audiences across the Gulf. For host cities it delivers a concentrated two-week influx of travelling supporters, media and delegations, with associated demand across hotels, transport, hospitality and retail.

For Saudi Arabia the Gulf Cup also functions as an operational rehearsal. The Kingdom is preparing to host the AFC Asian Cup in 2027 and the FIFA World Cup in 2034, and is building or upgrading a large portfolio of stadiums. Delivering a multi-team international tournament in Jeddah tests venue operations, transport planning, security, ticketing and broadcast infrastructure ahead of those larger commitments.
whatToExpect: A two-week group-stage and knockout tournament across two Jeddah stadiums, with fan zones, supporter travel from neighbouring Gulf states and full international broadcast. Expect ticketing through Saudi platforms and heavy matchday activity around King Abdullah Sports City.
venueName: King Abdullah Sports City and Prince Abdullah Al Faisal Stadium
venueAddress: King Abdullah Sports City, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
organizerName: Arab Gulf Cup Football Federation with the Saudi Arabian Football Federation

title: The Saudi Food Show 2026
tagline: The Kingdom's largest food and beverage sourcing event, relocating to the Jeddah Superdome.
shortDescription: The Saudi Food Show runs 27-29 September 2026 at the Jeddah Superdome, its first Jeddah edition, co-located with Saudifood Manufacturing to link ingredients, production and distribution.
description:
The Saudi Food Show is the Kingdom's largest food and beverage sourcing exhibition, and the 2026 edition marks a significant move: from 27 to 29 September it relocates to the Jeddah Superdome, positioning the show at Saudi Arabia's primary Red Sea trade and logistics gateway rather than in Riyadh.

The exhibition covers the full F&B spectrum — fresh produce and meat, dairy, bakery and confectionery, ambient and frozen products, beverages and coffee, ingredients and commodities, and food service equipment. It is now co-located with Saudifood Manufacturing, which brings processing machinery, packaging technology and production-line suppliers into the same building, creating a connected ecosystem from ingredients through production to finished product and distribution.

Buyers include wholesalers, distributors and importers, supermarket and convenience chains, hotel and restaurant groups, catering companies, and government procurement bodies, alongside investors and food-security agencies. Saudi Arabia imports a large share of its food while simultaneously investing in domestic production and food security through the Saudi Agricultural and Livestock Investment Company and localisation incentives, which makes the show relevant to both import trade and in-Kingdom manufacturing.
whatToExpect: A large exhibition floor with national and regional pavilions, extensive product tasting, live food demonstrations and chef competitions, plus conference sessions and structured buyer matchmaking. Expect afternoon and evening opening hours and heavy trade-buyer traffic.
venueAddress: Madinah Road, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

title: Saudifood Manufacturing 2026
tagline: Food processing, packaging and production technology co-located with The Saudi Food Show in Jeddah.
shortDescription: Saudifood Manufacturing runs 27-29 September 2026 at the Jeddah Superdome alongside The Saudi Food Show, covering food processing machinery, packaging and production technology.
description:
Saudifood Manufacturing is the food production technology counterpart to The Saudi Food Show, running from 27 to 29 September 2026 at the Jeddah Superdome as a co-located exhibition. Where the Food Show covers finished products and ingredients, Saudifood Manufacturing covers the equipment and systems used to make them.

Exhibit categories span food processing machinery, filling and packaging lines, cold chain and refrigeration, hygiene and food-safety systems, ingredients handling and dosing, laboratory and quality-control equipment, and factory automation and traceability software. Suppliers come predominantly from Europe, Turkey, China and India, alongside regional agents and service providers.

The commercial logic is Saudi Arabia's push to expand domestic food manufacturing. Food security is a stated national priority, the Kingdom is investing in local dairy, poultry, bakery and processed-food capacity, and localisation incentives favour in-Kingdom production over imported finished goods. Visitors are food manufacturers and plant engineers, packaging managers, quality and food-safety specialists, and investors developing new processing facilities, with the co-location giving them direct access to their own customer base on the same floor.
whatToExpect: Working processing and packaging machinery demonstrated on the stand, alongside automation and food-safety technology suppliers. Expect technical discussions with plant engineers, shared access with The Saudi Food Show halls, and equipment specification meetings.
venueAddress: Madinah Road, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

title: GESS Saudi Arabia 2026
tagline: The Kingdom's education technology and school supplies exhibition and conference.
shortDescription: GESS Saudi Arabia returns to Riyadh from 29 September to 1 October 2026, connecting educators with education technology, curriculum and school-resource suppliers.
description:
GESS Saudi Arabia is the Kingdom's edition of the Global Educational Supplies and Solutions brand, returning to Riyadh from 29 September to 1 October 2026. It combines an exhibition of education suppliers with an accredited conference programme for teachers, school leaders and education policymakers.

The exhibition covers classroom technology and interactive displays, learning management and school administration software, STEM and robotics kits, curriculum and publishing resources, early years and special educational needs provision, furniture and classroom design, and assessment and language-learning platforms. Exhibitors range from global EdTech platforms to Saudi and regional distributors and curriculum providers.

The conference strand offers continuing professional development sessions on pedagogy, digital learning, assessment, school leadership and inclusive education. Saudi Arabia is a very large education market with a young population, an extensive public school system undergoing curriculum reform, and rapid growth in private and international schooling, all supported by heavy government spending on education technology and teacher development. GESS is the main annual venue where that procurement and professional-development activity concentrates.
whatToExpect: An exhibition floor of classroom technology and learning resources with hands-on product trials, plus a multi-track CPD conference for teachers and school leaders. Expect large school and ministry delegations and practical workshop sessions.
venueAddress: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Saudi Green Building Forum 2026
tagline: Riyadh's sustainability forum for the built environment, recognised in the UN sustainability programme.
shortDescription: The Saudi Green Building Forum convenes in Riyadh from 1 October 2026, addressing sustainable construction, building performance and the circular economy in the built environment.
description:
The Saudi Green Building Forum (SGBF) is a Riyadh-based non-profit forum focused on sustainability in the built environment, and its annual conference convenes in Riyadh from 1 October 2026. The organisation holds observer and participatory status with United Nations bodies and has been added to the official programme of the UN High-Level Political Forum on Sustainable Development, which gives its conference unusual international standing for a national green-building body.

The programme covers green building codes and certification, energy and water performance in buildings, embodied carbon and sustainable materials, retrofit of existing stock, waste and circularity in construction, and the financing mechanisms — including green sukuk and endowment structures — that fund sustainable development. Sessions bring together government ministries, developers, engineering consultancies, certification bodies and researchers.

The Saudi context gives the forum practical weight. The Kingdom operates the Saudi Building Code with energy-efficiency provisions, the Saudi Green Initiative sets national emissions and afforestation targets, and the giga-projects have publicly committed to sustainability certifications at scale. Buildings account for a very large share of Saudi electricity consumption because of cooling loads, so building-performance policy has direct energy-economics consequences.
whatToExpect: A conference-format event with policy and technical sessions, research presentations and awards recognising sustainable projects. Expect participation from ministries, developers and consultants, and a strong focus on codes, certification and measurable building performance.
venueAddress: Ghirnatah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Saudi Halal Expo 2026
tagline: Riyadh's dedicated halal products and certification exhibition at RICEC.
shortDescription: The Saudi Halal Expo runs 4-6 October 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center, covering halal food, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, certification and logistics.
description:
The Saudi Halal Expo is a dedicated trade exhibition for the halal economy held from 4 to 6 October 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center, organised by 1st Arabia Tradeshows and Conferences. It covers halal food and beverage products, halal cosmetics and personal care, halal pharmaceuticals and nutraceuticals, certification and accreditation services, and halal-compliant logistics and cold chain.

The show is anchored in a specific policy development: the establishment of the Saudi Halal Center under the Saudi Food and Drug Authority, which builds domestic halal certification capability and sets standards for products entering the Saudi market. That gives exporters a concrete regulatory reason to attend, since market access depends on recognised certification.

Saudi Arabia is one of the largest halal consumer markets in the world by value, both through domestic consumption and through the pilgrim economy serving tens of millions of Umrah and Hajj visitors annually. The Kingdom also has ambitions to become a halal export hub rather than only an importer, supported by industrial localisation incentives. Visitors include importers and distributors, retail and food service buyers, certification bodies, and manufacturers seeking Saudi market entry.
whatToExpect: An exhibition of halal producers, certification bodies and logistics providers with country pavilions, plus seminars on certification requirements and Saudi market entry. Expect B2B matchmaking and a mix of food, cosmetics and pharmaceutical exhibitors.
venueAddress: 2446 King Abdullah Road, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Global Cybersecurity Forum 2026
tagline: Riyadh's international cyber policy forum, themed on institutionalising adaptive collaboration in cyberspace.
shortDescription: The Global Cybersecurity Forum Annual Meeting is held 7-8 October 2026 in Riyadh under the theme 'Institutionalizing Adaptive Collaborations in Cyberspace'.
description:
The Global Cybersecurity Forum (GCF) is a Riyadh-headquartered international platform for cyber policy, convened under royal patronage and closely associated with Saudi Arabia's National Cybersecurity Authority. Its annual meeting takes place on 7 and 8 October 2026 under the theme 'Institutionalizing Adaptive Collaborations in Cyberspace'.

GCF is deliberately positioned as a policy and strategy forum rather than a technical or vendor event. It brings together government cyber leadership, heads of national cyber agencies, chief information security officers from major enterprises, academics, multilateral organisations and non-governmental bodies, and it produces original research on issues such as the global cyber workforce gap, children's online safety, and the economics of cyber resilience.

The forum has established itself as one of the few consistent venues where cyber policy is discussed at head-of-agency level outside the Western institutional circuit, and it has run joint work with the World Economic Forum. For MENA business and government, GCF matters because Saudi Arabia has invested heavily in national cyber capability and regulatory frameworks, and because regional critical-infrastructure operators face a demonstrably elevated threat environment across energy, finance and government services.
whatToExpect: An invitation-weighted forum with plenary sessions, closed roundtables and research launches rather than an exhibition floor. Expect national cyber agency leadership, CISO-level attendance, and published reports and initiatives launched at the event.
venueAddress: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: WPC Energy Congress 2026
tagline: The 25th World Petroleum Congress, hosted by Saudi Arabia in Riyadh.
shortDescription: The 25th WPC Energy Congress takes place 11-15 October 2026 in Riyadh, the triennial global gathering of the petroleum and wider energy industry hosted for the first time by Saudi Arabia.
description:
The WPC Energy Congress, historically known as the World Petroleum Congress, is the triennial flagship event of WPC Energy and is often described as the Olympics of the oil and gas industry. The 25th edition takes place from 11 to 15 October 2026 in Riyadh, the first time Saudi Arabia has hosted the congress.

The congress convenes energy ministers, national and international oil company chief executives, service company leadership, technology providers, financiers and researchers. Programme content covers upstream and downstream technology, gas and LNG, refining and petrochemicals, carbon management and CCUS, hydrogen, energy security and market outlooks, digitalisation of energy operations, and the workforce and social-licence questions facing the industry through the energy transition.

Hosting matters for Saudi Arabia because it is the world's largest crude exporter, holds among the lowest-cost and lowest-carbon-intensity barrels, and is simultaneously investing in renewables, hydrogen and carbon capture. Riyadh will use the congress to present its position that the energy transition must be managed rather than abrupt, and the accompanying exhibition provides one of the largest procurement and partnership opportunities in the global energy calendar.
whatToExpect: A five-day congress combining ministerial plenaries, technical paper sessions and executive panels with a very large exhibition of national oil companies, service providers and technology vendors. Expect national pavilions, a youth and future-leaders programme, and major bilateral government and corporate meetings.
venueAddress: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
organizerName: WPC Energy with the Saudi Ministry of Energy

title: ITU Space Sustainability Forum 2026
tagline: The International Telecommunication Union's space sustainability forum, hosted in Riyadh.
shortDescription: The ITU Space Sustainability Forum 2026 is held 12-14 October 2026 in Riyadh, addressing spectrum, orbital resources and the long-term sustainability of satellite operations.
description:
The ITU Space Sustainability Forum is convened by the International Telecommunication Union, the United Nations specialised agency responsible for radio-frequency spectrum and satellite orbit coordination. The 2026 forum is hosted in Riyadh from 12 to 14 October, bringing the ITU's space agenda to Saudi Arabia.

The forum addresses the practical governance problems created by the rapid growth of satellite constellations: efficient use of spectrum and orbital slots, interference management, coordination between geostationary and non-geostationary systems, debris mitigation and end-of-life disposal practices, and equitable access to orbital resources for developing countries. Participants include national regulators and spectrum authorities, satellite operators and manufacturers, space agencies, and academic and legal experts.

Hosting in Riyadh reflects the Kingdom's growing engagement in space governance through the Saudi Space Agency and the Communications, Space and Technology Commission, which regulates both telecoms and space activity domestically. Saudi Arabia has also hosted its own Space Debris Conference and is investing in satellite communications and Earth-observation capability, so the ITU forum complements a broader national effort to sit inside the rule-making conversation rather than only consume space services.
whatToExpect: A UN-convened forum with regulatory and technical sessions, panel discussions and working-group meetings, held in a conference-centre setting. Expect participation from national spectrum regulators, satellite operators and international organisations, with formal outcome documents.
venueAddress: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Saudi International Pharma Expo 2026
tagline: The Kingdom's dedicated pharmaceutical, biotech and diagnostics exhibition at RICEC.
shortDescription: The fourth Saudi International Pharma Expo runs 12-14 October 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center, with over 120 exhibitors covering pharmaceuticals, biotech and diagnostics.
description:
The Saudi International Pharma Expo is the Kingdom's dedicated pharmaceutical industry exhibition, holding its fourth edition from 12 to 14 October 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center. Organised by 1st Arabia Tradeshows & Conferences, it expects more than 120 exhibitors and around 5,000 visitors.

The show covers finished pharmaceuticals and generics, active pharmaceutical ingredients and excipients, biotechnology and biosimilars, laboratory and diagnostics equipment, pharmaceutical manufacturing and packaging machinery, cold chain and distribution, and regulatory and pharmacovigilance services. It connects manufacturers and contract manufacturers with Saudi distributors, hospital and pharmacy chains, and government procurement bodies.

The policy driver is pharmaceutical localisation. Saudi Arabia has set explicit targets to increase domestic production of medicines and vaccines, backed by the National Industrial Development and Logistics Program, preferential procurement for locally manufactured products, and investment through PIF-affiliated healthcare vehicles. The Saudi Food and Drug Authority's registration regime is a central practical topic for exhibitors, since market access depends on it. Visitors include pharmacists, hospital procurement teams, regulatory affairs specialists, distributors and investors in healthcare manufacturing.
whatToExpect: An exhibition of pharmaceutical manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, laboratory equipment vendors and packaging companies, with country pavilions. Expect regulatory seminars on SFDA registration, distributor appointment meetings and hospital procurement attendance.
venueAddress: 2446 King Abdullah Road, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: The Coffee Show Jeddah 2026
tagline: Saudi Arabia's speciality coffee trade show at the Jeddah Superdome.
shortDescription: The Coffee Show opens 12-14 October 2026 at the Jeddah Superdome, covering speciality coffee, roasting and brewing equipment, café concepts and Saudi coffee production.
description:
The Coffee Show is Saudi Arabia's dedicated speciality coffee trade exhibition, held from 12 to 14 October 2026 at the Jeddah Superdome. It covers green coffee sourcing and importing, roasting and brewing equipment, café and roastery concepts, packaging, and barista training and competitions.

Saudi Arabia has one of the most dynamic coffee markets in the world. Traditional Arabic coffee is culturally central, while the speciality third-wave café segment has expanded rapidly in Riyadh, Jeddah and the Eastern Province, with homegrown Saudi chains now exporting their concepts regionally. The government designated a Year of Saudi Coffee and has invested in domestic coffee cultivation in the Jazan highlands, where Khawlani coffee has UNESCO intangible heritage recognition.

That combination gives the show an unusual mix of participants: international green coffee traders and equipment manufacturers, Saudi farmers and cooperatives, café chain operators and franchisors, roasters, and hospitality buyers. Programming typically includes barista and latte-art competitions, cupping sessions, roasting masterclasses, and business sessions on café unit economics and supply-chain sourcing.
whatToExpect: A show floor of roasters, equipment stands and café concepts with continuous tasting and cupping, plus competition stages for baristas and latte art. Expect a mix of trade buyers, café owners and enthusiastic consumer visitors.
venueAddress: Madinah Road, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

title: Saudi Agriculture 2026
tagline: The 43rd Saudi Agriculture exhibition, held with Saudi Agrofood, FoodPack and Aquaculture.
shortDescription: Saudi Agriculture 2026 runs 19-22 October 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center, with more than 430 international exhibitors across agriculture, agrofood, packaging and aquaculture.
description:
Saudi Agriculture is the Kingdom's longest-running agricultural exhibition, holding its 43rd edition from 19 to 22 October 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center. It is held together with Saudi Agrofood, Saudi FoodPack and Saudi Aquaculture, creating a combined platform covering agriculture, food production, packaging and fisheries.

The show attracts more than 430 international exhibitors across agricultural machinery and irrigation systems, greenhouse and protected-cultivation technology, seeds, fertilisers and crop protection, livestock and poultry equipment, veterinary products, aquaculture systems, food processing and packaging, and water management and treatment for agricultural use.

The strategic frame is food security in an extremely arid country. Saudi Arabia has phased out water-intensive cereal cultivation, invested heavily in controlled-environment agriculture and hydroponics, expanded aquaculture along both coasts through the National Fisheries Development Program, and pursued overseas agricultural investment through SALIC. Visitors are farm owners and agribusiness managers, government agriculture and water officials, food processors, veterinary and livestock operators, and distributors of agricultural inputs and machinery across the Gulf.
whatToExpect: Indoor halls of agricultural technology, inputs and processing equipment plus outdoor machinery displays, with country pavilions from major agricultural exporters. Expect technical seminars, livestock and aquaculture zones, and ministry-led delegations.
venueAddress: 2446 King Abdullah Road, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Saudi Maritime and Logistics Congress 2026
tagline: The Kingdom's largest shipping and logistics gathering, in its seventh edition at the Jeddah Superdome.
shortDescription: The seventh Saudi Maritime & Logistics Congress takes place 21-22 October 2026 at the Jeddah Superdome, expecting 15,000-plus attendees, 200 exhibitors and 120 speakers from over 90 countries.
description:
The Saudi Maritime & Logistics Congress is the Kingdom's largest shipping and logistics event, produced under the Seatrade Maritime banner and holding its seventh edition on 21 and 22 October 2026 at the Jeddah Superdome. Organisers expect more than 15,000 attendees, over 800 VIPs from more than 90 countries, 200-plus exhibitors and around 120 speakers, with free registration for visitors.

The agenda covers port development and terminal concessions, container and bulk shipping markets, shipbuilding and ship repair including the International Maritime Industries yard at Ras Al Khair, maritime decarbonisation and alternative fuels, digitalisation of port operations, and the integration of sea, rail and road logistics corridors.

Jeddah is the natural venue: Jeddah Islamic Port is Saudi Arabia's largest container gateway on the Red Sea and sits on one of the world's busiest trade lanes through the Suez Canal and Bab el-Mandeb. Saudi Arabia's National Transport and Logistics Strategy targets a large increase in port throughput and the development of logistics zones, and Red Sea security disruptions have made routing and resilience a live commercial topic for the shipping lines, freight forwarders, port operators and shippers who attend.
whatToExpect: A two-day congress with conference stages and an exhibition of ports, shipping lines, logistics providers and maritime technology firms. Registration is free for visitors. Expect senior port authority and shipping line participation, plus regional freight forwarder attendance.
venueAddress: Madinah Road, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

title: AlUla Wellness Festival 2026
tagline: Desert wellness programming in AlUla, expanded with new endurance and fitness events.
shortDescription: The AlUla Wellness Festival runs 23-31 October 2026 across AlUla's desert and oasis landscapes, adding new endurance and fitness events to its wellness and mindfulness programme.
description:
The AlUla Wellness Festival is part of the AlUla Moments cultural and experience calendar run by the Royal Commission for AlUla, and the 2026 edition runs from 23 to 31 October. It uses the valley's desert canyons, oasis palm groves and heritage sites as the setting for a week of wellness programming.

The festival combines movement and mindfulness — yoga, meditation, breathwork and sound sessions staged at sunrise and sunset in dramatic natural settings — with nutrition and holistic health workshops, spa and recovery experiences, and talks from wellness practitioners. The 2026 edition expands into endurance and fitness with new athletic events, broadening the audience beyond restorative wellness into active sport.

Wellness tourism is a deliberate pillar of AlUla's development strategy, alongside archaeology, arts and adventure. The destination has been positioning itself for high-value, low-density visitation, with luxury desert resorts, wellness retreats and a growing hospitality inventory. The festival serves both to fill shoulder-season capacity and to establish AlUla's identity in a global wellness travel market where destination differentiation depends heavily on landscape and authenticity.
whatToExpect: Sunrise and sunset sessions staged in canyons, oases and heritage settings, plus workshops, spa experiences and new endurance and fitness events. Expect small-group bookable experiences rather than mass attendance, with hospitality packages through AlUla resorts.
venueName: AlUla oasis, canyons and heritage sites
venueAddress: AlUla, Medina Province, Saudi Arabia

title: Future Investment Initiative 2026
tagline: FII10, the tenth-anniversary edition of Riyadh's global investment conference, themed 'The Power of Legacy'.
shortDescription: The 10th Future Investment Initiative runs 26-29 October 2026 at the King Abdulaziz International Conference Center in Riyadh under the theme 'The Power of Legacy'.
description:
The Future Investment Initiative (FII) is Riyadh's flagship global investment conference, convened by the FII Institute and held under the patronage of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques. The tenth-anniversary edition runs from 26 to 29 October 2026 at the King Abdulaziz International Conference Center under the theme 'The Power of Legacy'.

FII10 is organised around four pillars: capital that builds, technology that elevates, societies that thrive and leadership that inspires. The programme brings together heads of state, sovereign wealth and asset-management leadership, technology founders, industrialists and policymakers to discuss capital allocation, artificial intelligence, energy transition, healthcare and longevity, and the geopolitics of investment. The FII Institute also publishes research and runs year-round programming, including regional FII PRIORITY summits in Miami, Hong Kong and Europe.

The conference has become one of the most consequential investment gatherings in the world by attendee seniority, with hundreds of billions of dollars in deals and memoranda announced around past editions. For MENA business it is the single clearest annual signal of where Saudi and Gulf sovereign capital intends to deploy, and it draws a concentrated international investor presence into Riyadh for a week.
whatToExpect: A tightly produced conference with main-stage interviews, closed-door investor roundtables and an accompanying exhibition and innovation showcase. Access is invitation and paid-delegate based. Expect heads of state, global CEO participation and significant deal announcements timed to the event.
venueAddress: King Abdulaziz Road, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Global Health Exhibition 2026
tagline: Saudi Arabia's premier healthcare business platform, now in its ninth edition.
shortDescription: The ninth Global Health Exhibition runs 26-29 October 2026 in Riyadh, expecting more than 130,000 healthcare professionals and over 2,200 healthcare brands.
description:
The Global Health Exhibition is Saudi Arabia's largest healthcare event, organised by Informa Markets and held from 26 to 29 October 2026 in Riyadh for its ninth edition. Organisers expect more than 130,000 professional attendees and over 2,200 domestic and international healthcare brands.

The exhibition spans medical devices and equipment, hospital build and infrastructure, diagnostics and laboratory technology, digital health and health information systems, pharmaceuticals, rehabilitation and long-term care, and healthcare workforce and training services. The conference programme runs alongside with leadership forums and specialised streams on artificial intelligence in healthcare, digital transformation, healthcare investment and privatisation, workforce development and patient-centred care.

The event's scale reflects the Health Sector Transformation Program, one of the largest Vision 2030 realisation programmes. Saudi Arabia is restructuring healthcare delivery through accountable-care organisations under the Health Holding Company, privatising selected services, building new hospital capacity, and investing in digital health infrastructure and health data platforms. That makes the exhibition a major procurement venue for ministry, cluster and private-hospital buyers as well as a policy forum.
whatToExpect: Very large exhibition halls with device manufacturers, hospital suppliers and digital health vendors, plus multiple conference theatres running accredited clinical and management content. Expect ministry and hospital-cluster procurement delegations and country pavilions.
venueAddress: Malham, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: New Global Sport Conference 2026
tagline: NGSC26 in Riyadh, themed 'Defining Victory: Shaping Gaming for the Next Era of Competition'.
shortDescription: The New Global Sport Conference runs 30 October to 1 November 2026 at the Sofitel Riyadh Hotel & Convention Centre, ahead of the inaugural Esports Nations Cup.
description:
The New Global Sport Conference (NGSC) is the esports and gaming industry conference staged by the Esports World Cup Foundation in Riyadh. The 2026 edition runs from 30 October to 1 November at the Sofitel Riyadh Hotel & Convention Centre under the theme 'Defining Victory: Shaping Gaming for the Next Era of Competition — AI, Capital & Monetization', positioned immediately ahead of the inaugural Esports Nations Cup.

The conference brings together publishers and developers, esports team owners and league operators, broadcasters and platforms, sponsors and rights holders, and investors. Programming addresses the commercial architecture of competitive gaming: monetisation models, media rights and distribution, club economics and ownership structures, the role of AI in development and competition, sponsorship and brand integration, and the convergence of esports with traditional sport.

NGSC matters because Saudi Arabia has become the single largest source of capital in the esports sector through the Esports World Cup Foundation, Savvy Games Group and PIF's publisher holdings, and the conference is where those investors and their portfolio ecosystem meet the wider industry. The 2026 edition also marks the conference's first international extension, with a curated summit planned during the Esports World Cup in Paris.
whatToExpect: A hotel-based conference with keynote sessions, industry panels and invitation-only executive roundtables rather than a public exhibition. Expect publisher and team-owner attendance, deal-focused networking, and announcements tied to the Esports Nations Cup that follows.
venueAddress: King Fahd Road, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Riyadh Season 2026
tagline: The world's largest entertainment season, returning to Riyadh from October across multiple themed zones.
shortDescription: Riyadh Season returns from October 2026 through the following spring, with themed entertainment zones, world championship sport, exhibitions and hundreds of concerts across the capital.
description:
Riyadh Season is the flagship entertainment programme of Saudi Arabia's General Entertainment Authority and the largest annual entertainment season in the world by scale of programming. Following the pattern established since 2019, the 2026-27 edition opens in October 2026 and runs through to the following spring across multiple purpose-built zones in the capital.

Recent editions have run eleven or more themed zones — including Boulevard City, Boulevard World, VIA Riyadh and Winter Wonderland — alongside more than a dozen world championship sporting events, dozens of exhibitions and hundreds of concerts. Zones are effectively temporary districts with restaurants, retail, theatres, arenas and rides, and Kingdom Arena hosts internationally broadcast boxing, wrestling and MMA cards.

The season's economic function is substantial: it underpins domestic tourism, supports a large temporary workforce, drives hotel occupancy through the winter, and has become the anchor client for Saudi Arabia's live-events supply chain of staging, production, security and F&B operators. For brands it is the largest concentrated consumer-marketing opportunity in the Kingdom, and for international promoters and rights holders it is now a routine stop on the global touring and event calendar.
whatToExpect: Multiple ticketed entertainment zones open nightly across Riyadh, with concerts, arena sport, immersive attractions, restaurants and retail. Expect ticketing via national platforms, very large weekend crowds, and a rolling programme announced in stages through the season.
venueName: Multiple zones across Riyadh including Boulevard City and Kingdom Arena
venueAddress: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: IDRA World Congress 2026
tagline: The International Desalination and Reuse Association's world congress, hosted in Riyadh.
shortDescription: The IDRA World Congress 2026 takes place 1-5 November 2026 at the King Faisal Convention Center in Riyadh, the leading global technical gathering on desalination and water reuse.
description:
The IDRA World Congress is the flagship event of the International Desalination and Reuse Association and the leading global technical conference on desalination and water reuse. The 2026 congress takes place from 1 to 5 November at the King Faisal Convention Center at the InterContinental Riyadh.

The programme covers thermal and membrane desalination technology, reverse osmosis energy efficiency and membrane development, brine management and minerals recovery, water reuse and advanced treatment, renewable-powered desalination, digital operations and predictive maintenance for plants, and the financing and procurement models used to deliver large water projects. It combines peer-reviewed technical papers with utility case studies and a supplier exhibition.

Hosting in Riyadh is logical given that Saudi Arabia is among the world's largest producers of desalinated water and operates some of the biggest plants ever built. The sector has been restructured around the Saudi Water Authority and the Saudi Water Partnership Company's independent water project model, and the Kingdom has driven significant reductions in the energy intensity of desalination. Delegates include utility operators, EPC contractors, membrane and equipment manufacturers, consultants and researchers from across the Gulf, Asia, Europe and the Americas.
whatToExpect: A week-long technical congress with parallel paper sessions, workshops and utility case studies alongside a supplier exhibition. Expect a strongly engineering and utility-led delegate base, plant technical tours and international association working meetings.
venueName: King Faisal Convention Center, InterContinental Riyadh
venueAddress: Ma'ather Street, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Esports Nations Cup 2026
tagline: The inaugural national-team esports championship, staged across a month in Riyadh.
shortDescription: The inaugural Esports Nations Cup runs 2-29 November 2026 in Riyadh, a national-team format competition organised by the Esports World Cup Foundation.
description:
The Esports Nations Cup is a new national-team competition organised by the Esports World Cup Foundation, with its inaugural edition running in Riyadh from 2 to 29 November 2026. Where the Esports World Cup is contested by professional clubs, the Nations Cup is structured around countries, with national rosters competing under their flags.

The national-team format is a deliberate attempt to broaden esports' appeal beyond club fandom into the country-versus-country dynamic that drives audiences for traditional international sport. It also creates a pathway for national esports federations, which have been formalising across the Gulf, Asia and Europe, to field teams and build domestic qualification structures.

The event runs immediately after the New Global Sport Conference, which is scheduled deliberately to precede it and give the industry a business platform alongside the competition. Together they extend Saudi Arabia's esports calendar beyond the summer Esports World Cup into the autumn, supporting the National Gaming and Esports Strategy's goal of making the Kingdom a permanent hub for competitive gaming rather than the host of a single annual event.
whatToExpect: A month-long tournament in Riyadh venues with national-team rosters, live audiences and international broadcast. Expect fan zones, national supporter groups, and a staged schedule where different game titles run in sequence across the four weeks.
venueAddress: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Saudi Elenex 2026
tagline: The Kingdom's electricity, power generation and lighting technology exhibition.
shortDescription: Saudi Elenex 2026 is held in early November 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center, covering power generation, transmission, distribution and lighting technology.
description:
Saudi Elenex is the Kingdom's specialist trade exhibition for the electricity and power sector, held at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center in early November 2026. It covers power generation equipment, transmission and distribution systems, switchgear and cabling, transformers, energy storage, renewable energy technology, electrical installation products and lighting.

The Saudi power sector is undergoing a substantial restructuring. The Kingdom is targeting a roughly balanced mix of renewables and gas in generation, has procured multi-gigawatt solar and wind projects through the National Renewable Energy Program and PIF's renewable pipeline, is displacing crude oil burn from power generation, and is building interconnection with neighbouring grids. The Saudi Electricity Company's network expansion and smart-metering rollout add a large distribution-equipment demand stream.

The show is held alongside related industrial exhibitions and draws visitors including utility engineers, electrical contractors, industrial plant electrical teams, consultants and specifiers, and distributors of electrical products. Exhibitors are predominantly manufacturers from China, Turkey, Korea, Italy and Germany, alongside Saudi and Gulf manufacturers benefiting from local-content preferences in utility procurement.
whatToExpect: An exhibition of switchgear, transformers, cabling, lighting and renewable energy equipment with manufacturer and distributor stands. Expect utility and contractor visitor traffic, technical product presentations, and local-content and certification discussions.
venueAddress: 2446 King Abdullah Road, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Jeddah International Motor Show 2026
tagline: The Red Sea city's automotive showcase for new models, EVs and aftermarket brands.
shortDescription: The Jeddah International Motor Show returns 4-7 November 2026, presenting new vehicle launches, electric models, luxury and classic cars and aftermarket brands to the western region.
description:
The Jeddah International Motor Show is the western region's principal automotive exhibition, returning from 4 to 7 November 2026. It presents new model launches from manufacturers and their Saudi distributors, electric and hybrid vehicles, luxury and performance brands, classic and modified cars, and aftermarket products and accessories.

Saudi Arabia is the largest automotive market in the Middle East by volume, and Jeddah has historically been one of its most significant retail centres. The market is shifting: the Kingdom is building a domestic automotive manufacturing base through Lucid's assembly plant, the PIF-backed Ceer electric vehicle brand and the Hyundai joint venture, while charging infrastructure is being rolled out through the Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Company.

That gives the show a dual character — a consumer-facing showcase where dealers convert visitor interest into orders, and an industry signal of how quickly electrification is landing in a market historically defined by inexpensive fuel and large-displacement vehicles. Visitors include retail car buyers, fleet managers, dealers and distributors, and automotive media, with manufacturer stands typically staffed for direct sales and financing conversations.
whatToExpect: A consumer-facing exhibition of manufacturer and dealer stands with new model reveals, test-drive and static display areas, and aftermarket and accessory zones. Expect evening-weighted family attendance, on-stand sales and finance desks, and motoring media activity.
venueAddress: Jeddah, Makkah Province, Saudi Arabia

title: Biban Forum 2026
tagline: Monsha'at's flagship SME and entrepreneurship forum, the Kingdom's largest gathering for small business.
shortDescription: Biban 2026 runs 5-8 November 2026 at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Conference Center, convening SME founders, investors, financiers and government enablers under Monsha'at.
description:
Biban is the flagship forum of Monsha'at, the Small and Medium Enterprises General Authority, and is the largest entrepreneurship and SME event in Saudi Arabia. The 2026 edition runs from 5 to 8 November at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Conference Center.

The forum brings together SME founders and entrepreneurs, venture and private-capital investors, banks and alternative financiers, government agencies and regulators, franchisors, and business-service providers. Its practical value lies in the on-site services: licensing and registration desks, financing and guarantee programme applications, investment matchmaking sessions, business competitions with prize funding, and training and knowledge programmes delivered across the four days.

Biban matters because SMEs are a headline Vision 2030 target, with the Kingdom aiming to lift their share of GDP substantially. Monsha'at operates funding, incubation and market-access programmes, and Biban is where those are distributed at scale to a broad national audience rather than only to the venture-backed startup segment. Recent editions have hosted the global finals of the Entrepreneurship World Cup and concluded with agreements worth billions of dollars, making it commercially as well as symbolically significant.
whatToExpect: Large exhibition halls combining government service desks, financier and bank stands, franchise and supplier zones, and startup pavilions, with multiple stages of workshops and pitch competitions. Expect very high footfall from Saudi small-business owners and aspiring founders.
venueAddress: Riyadh Front, Airport Road, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
organizerName: Monsha'at — Small and Medium Enterprises General Authority

title: Hajj Conference and Exhibition 2026
tagline: The fifth Hajj Conference & Exhibition at the Jeddah Superdome, themed 'From Makkah to the World'.
shortDescription: The fifth Hajj Conference & Exhibition runs 8-11 November 2026 at the Jeddah Superdome, with 280-plus exhibitors, 950 global delegates and an exhibition floor exceeding 52,000 square metres.
description:
The Hajj Conference & Exhibition is organised by the Saudi Ministry of Hajj and Umrah in partnership with the Pilgrim Experience Program, one of the Vision 2030 realisation programmes. The fifth edition runs from 8 to 11 November 2026 at the Jeddah Superdome under the theme 'From Makkah to the World'.

The event pairs a conference of more than 80 sessions and 60 specialised workshops with an exhibition covering over 52,000 square metres, hosting more than 280 exhibitors from upwards of 90 countries and expecting to engage around 950 global delegates and very large visitor numbers. Participants include Hajj mission and affairs offices from pilgrim-sending countries, tour operators, transport and accommodation providers, catering and crowd-management specialists, and technology companies serving pilgrim services.

Its commercial importance is considerable. The Kingdom serves tens of millions of Umrah and Hajj pilgrims annually and has set targets to increase that substantially, which drives investment in hotel capacity, transport including the Haramain high-speed rail, digital permit and booking platforms such as Nusuk, and crowd-safety technology. The exhibition is where much of that procurement and partnership activity is transacted, with previous editions producing hundreds of signed cooperation agreements.
whatToExpect: A very large exhibition of pilgrim-services providers, technology firms and national Hajj mission pavilions, running alongside a dense conference and workshop programme. Expect government delegations from pilgrim-sending countries, agreement signings and high visitor volumes.
venueAddress: Madinah Road, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
organizerName: Ministry of Hajj and Umrah with the Pilgrim Experience Program

title: Riyadh EV Auto Show 2026
tagline: The Kingdom's dedicated electric vehicle and charging infrastructure exhibition.
shortDescription: The Riyadh EV Auto Show returns 9-11 November 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Centre, covering electric vehicles, batteries and charging infrastructure.
description:
The Riyadh EV Auto Show is Saudi Arabia's dedicated electric mobility exhibition, returning from 9 to 11 November 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Centre. It covers battery electric and hybrid vehicles, charging hardware and networks, battery technology and recycling, EV components and manufacturing, and fleet electrification services.

The show tracks a genuine structural shift. Saudi Arabia has committed significant capital to electric mobility through PIF's controlling stake in Lucid Motors and its Jeddah assembly plant, the Ceer national EV brand developed with BMW and Foxconn, a joint venture with Hyundai, and the Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Company which is rolling out public charging across the Kingdom. Riyadh has set a target for a substantial share of vehicles in the capital to be electric by 2030.

Visitors include fleet operators and corporate mobility managers, dealers and distributors, charging network developers, utility and grid planners, and consumers evaluating EV ownership in a market where fuel costs have historically discouraged it. Exhibitors range from vehicle manufacturers and importers, including a strong Chinese OEM presence, to charging equipment vendors, battery suppliers and energy management software providers.
whatToExpect: A show floor of electric vehicles with test-drive and static display areas, charging hardware demonstrations and battery technology stands. Expect fleet-buyer engagement, charging infrastructure partnership discussions and consumer visitors evaluating models.
venueAddress: 2446 King Abdullah Road, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Misk Global Forum 2026
tagline: The Misk Foundation's youth leadership and future-of-work forum at Misk City in Riyadh.
shortDescription: Misk Global Forum 2026 is held 11-12 November 2026 at Mohammed bin Salman Nonprofit City in Riyadh, focused on youth leadership, skills and the future of work.
description:
The Misk Global Forum is the annual convening of the Mohammed bin Salman Foundation (Misk), held on 11 and 12 November 2026 at Mohammed bin Salman Nonprofit City in Riyadh. It is built around youth leadership, entrepreneurship, skills and the future of work, and has become one of the most internationally visible Saudi platforms aimed at people under 35.

Programming combines main-stage sessions with global figures from business, technology, media and public life, practical skills workshops and bootcamps, startup and creative showcases, and career and scholarship pathways delivered through Misk's academies and programmes. The forum typically produces partnership agreements between Misk and international universities, companies and non-profits that create fellowships, internships and training placements for Saudi young people.

The underlying rationale is demographic: a very large share of the Saudi population is under 35, and the success of Vision 2030 depends on equipping that cohort with employable skills and entrepreneurial capacity. Misk operates year-round through its academies, art institute, innovation and entrepreneurship programmes, and the forum is the point at which that portfolio is presented publicly and connected to international networks.
whatToExpect: A two-day forum at Misk City with main-stage talks, hands-on workshops, startup and creative showcases and career pathway zones. Expect a young delegate profile, international speakers, and partnership announcements around fellowships and training programmes.
venueName: Mohammed bin Salman Nonprofit City (Misk City)
venueAddress: Mohammed bin Salman Nonprofit City, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

title: Cityscape Global 2026
tagline: The world's most attended real estate exhibition, staged in Riyadh across four days.
shortDescription: Cityscape Global 2026 runs 16-19 November 2026 at the Riyadh Exhibition & Convention Centre in Malham, with 170,000-plus attendees, 500-plus exhibitors and 450-plus speakers.
description:
Cityscape Global is the world's most attended real estate exhibition and has been staged in Riyadh since 2023, having relocated from Dubai. The 2026 edition runs from 16 to 19 November at the Riyadh Exhibition & Convention Centre in Malham, with organisers citing more than 170,000 attendees, over 500 exhibitors and more than 450 speakers across four days.

The show combines a mass-market property sales floor with an institutional investment and urban-development conference. Exhibitors include Saudi and international developers, the giga-projects such as NEOM, Qiddiya, Diriyah, Roshn and New Murabba, mortgage lenders and real-estate finance providers, PropTech platforms, and government housing and planning bodies. Visitors range from individual home buyers to institutional investors and city planners.

The commercial output is unusually measurable for an exhibition: the 2025 edition recorded around SAR 237 billion, roughly US$63 billion, in real-estate transactions across the four days.
